title: An Efficient Parallel Fault Simulator for Functional Patterns on Multi-Core Systems
problem: Functional pattern fault simulation is critical for validating safety mechanisms but computationally expensive; existing simulators lack efficient parallelization.
motivation: Functional safety verification requires exhaustive fault simulation; acceleration is necessary for design efficiency and time-to-market in safety-critical systems.
method: Three-pronged acceleration on multi-core CPU: (1) Fault filtering removes provably non-critical faults early; (2) Fault grouping batches similar faults to share computation; (3) CPU-based parallelism distributes faults across cores. Techniques are tailored to characteristics of functional patterns.
key_novelty: Integrated fault filtering, grouping, and parallelization strategy specifically optimized for functional pattern fault simulation workload characteristics.
contributions: 79x average speedup on 48-core system vs commercial tool
Techniques tailored to functional pattern simulation specifics
limitations: Evaluation on single benchmark or tool; comparison to other open-source fault simulators and scalability beyond 48 cores not discussed.
primary_theme: parallel functional fault simulation via filtering and grouping
